## Verdict

**FAIL**

- plan: PASS

- review: PASS, but it missed F1

- final: FAIL: F1 CRIT, any caller reads any order

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  C[GET /orders/:id] --> G{CallerGuard} --> S[OrdersService.get: by id only]
```

findings.problem: GET /orders/:id returns any order to any caller: OrdersService.get loads the order by id only and never compares order.userId with the caller (req.callerId). CallerGuard authenticates, nothing authorizes (IDOR, OWASP A01).
findings.failure_scenario: Caller X-User-Id: 3 sends GET /orders/16, an order of user 4: 200 with user 4's order. Walking ids 1..250 reads every customer's orders.
findings.fix: Pass req.callerId to OrdersService.get and load with where {id, userId: callerId} (findFirst), 404 when not found; add an e2e test: another user's order answers 404.
